name: crossbowman
description: a Crossbowman, a bearded human soldier: a wide-brimmed steel kettle helmet, a brown beard, a grey chain-mail shirt over a brown leather jerkin with rolled-up sleeves and bare tan forearms, a brown belt with a square steel buckle, a quiver of white-fletched bolts and a brown pouch at his hip on the screen-left side, brown trousers and tall brown leather boots, aiming a wooden crossbow with a curved steel prod to the right, its stock under his cheek gripped in his RIGHT hand and its fore-end held in his LEFT hand
hands: the crossbow's stock stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the fore-end under the prod, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut under the kettle helmet, torso jolts back; the crossbow stays gripped by its stock in his right hand at his chest, jolted so its front end dips a little, still pointing to the right; the left hand lets go of the fore-end and is pulled in against his belly as an empty fist
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crossbow still held across his chest in the right hand, pointing to the right and dipping a little, the empty left fist held in against his belly

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the crossbow arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops under the kettle helmet, the crossbow lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crossbow's front end resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crossbow slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the kettle helmet on his head; the crossbow lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the helmet stays on
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crossbow on the ground beside him
